blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) has stepped up road safety operations ahead of the Undas exodus, directing police commanders nationwide to prevent road accidents and help ensure that families reach their destinations and return home safely. In a statement, PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr. ordered regional and local police units to strengthen patrols along major highways, accident-prone roads, and routes leading to cemeteries and transport terminals as millions of Filipinos prepare to travel for the annual observance.
